profile.tagline: Building responsive, high-performance digital experiences with modern web technologies and full stack frameworks, while bringing an engineering mindset rooted in Electronics and Embedded Systems.
profile.bio_intro: I am an Associate Web Developer and Software Engineer with an engineering degree in Electronics and Communication from K Ramakrishnan College of Engineering. I specialize in building responsive, accessible, high-performance web applications, managing enterprise CMS platforms, and engineering full-stack solutions.
profile.bio_engineering: With an academic foundation in Electronics & Communication Engineering (CGPA: 7.56), I bring rigorous systems thinking, hardware-software integration knowledge, microcontroller familiarity (Embedded C), and industrial automation concepts (PLC ladder logic) to complex technical challenges.
profile.bio_software: Professionally, I manage enterprise web properties at VDart, delivering custom WordPress frontend solutions, responsive web layouts (HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript), technical SEO and AIEO optimizations, GA4 analytics instrumentation, and AI chatbot integrations using Node.js and the Gemini API.
profile.bio_philosophy: My technical versatility spans React.js, Node.js, Core Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, MySQL, and MongoDB. I focus on clean code, web accessibility standards, cross-browser compatibility, and measurable business impact.

projects.title: CT Lung Image Enhancement & Segmentation Using Pythagorean Fuzzy Set
projects.summary: Digital medical image processing model designed to enhance contrast and segment pulmonary CT scans using mathematical Pythagorean fuzzy set theory for accurate diagnostic interpretation.
projects.problem: Low contrast, ambient noise, and ambiguous edge gradients in pulmonary CT scans hinder accurate segmentation of lung parenchyma and subtle pathological tissues.
projects.approach: Developed an image processing model to enhance and segment CT scan images using Pythagorean fuzzy set membership and non-membership functions to improve diagnostic contrast.
projects.architecture:
Methodology: Pythagorean Fuzzy Set (PFS) Mathematical Framework
Domain: Digital Signal & Image Processing
Data: CT Scan Image Datasets & Boundary Matrices
projects.tech_stack: ["Digital Image Processing","Pythagorean Fuzzy Sets","Signal Processing","Data Analysis","Problem Solving"]
projects.features: ["Developed an image processing model to enhance and segment CT scan images","Applied algorithm-based data analysis for improving accuracy","Worked on handling digital signals and image datasets","Gained experience in data interpretation and technical problem-solving"]
projects.challenges: Overcoming ambiguous voxel boundaries and noise artifacts between healthy tissue and lesion boundaries in low-contrast scans.
projects.solution: Formulated membership, non-membership, and hesitancy degrees under Pythagorean fuzzy constraints, effectively expanding the contrast spectrum across edge gradients.
projects.result: Significantly improved tissue boundary delineation and automated segmentation accuracy for clinical analysis.

projects.title: Easy Transfer Application — Secure Funds Transfer System
projects.summary: Secure fund transfer system built using Core Java, JDBC, and MySQL with robust transaction validation, structured exception handling, and modular OOP architecture.
projects.problem: Financial fund transfers require absolute transactional consistency, preventing partial debit/credit executions and ensuring data integrity under unexpected database disconnects.
projects.approach: Developed a secure fund transfer system using Core Java and JDBC. Implemented transaction validation, structured exception handling, modular architecture, and optimized SQL queries.
projects.architecture:
Language: Core Java (OOP Principles)
Connectivity: JDBC (Java Database Connectivity)
Database: MySQL with ACID Transaction Management
Version Control: Git / GitHub
projects.features: ["Developed a secure fund transfer system using Core Java and JDBC","Implemented transaction validation, structured exception handling, and modular architecture","Optimized SQL queries and ensured data integrity with MySQL","Prevented SQL injection vulnerabilities through parameterized statements"]
projects.challenges: Guaranteeing atomic transactions so neither sender nor receiver balances could be desynchronized during mid-operation failure.
projects.solution: Applied explicit JDBC transaction boundaries (`setAutoCommit(false)`) with rollback routines in exception handling blocks.
projects.result: Verified 100% data consistency across multi-account concurrent transfer simulations.

projects.title: Sensor-Based Water Level Monitoring System
projects.summary: Automated embedded monitoring system using microcontrollers and water level sensors programmed in Embedded C for real-time liquid monitoring and automated pump control.
projects.problem: Water overflow in storage tanks and dry-run damage to electric pumps cause substantial resource waste and mechanical motor failure.
projects.approach: Designed and developed an automated water level monitoring system using a microcontroller and water level sensors. Programmed the controller using Embedded C for real-time monitoring and pump control.
projects.architecture:
Hardware: Microcontroller Unit (MCU), Water Level Sensors, Relay Module
Programming: Embedded C
Testing: Circuit Simulation & Hardware Troubleshooting
projects.features: ["Designed and developed an automated water level monitoring system using a microcontroller and water level sensors","Programmed the controller using Embedded C for real-time monitoring and pump control","Implemented automatic pump ON/OFF functionality based on predefined water levels","Performed testing and troubleshooting to ensure reliable operation"]
projects.challenges: Preventing sensor corrosion and erratic relay switching caused by surface ripples.
projects.solution: Engineered software hysteresis timing thresholds in Embedded C and selected corrosion-resistant sensing probes.
projects.result: Achieved autonomous pump automation with zero water overflow and reliable motor protection.

projects.title: PLC-Based Industrial Motor Control System
projects.summary: Industrial automation motor start/stop control system designed using PLC ladder logic programming with sensor-based safety interlocks and fault detection.
projects.problem: Industrial electric motors require automated start/stop cycling with thermal overload safeguards and immediate emergency shutoff interlocks to ensure workplace safety.
projects.approach: Designed PLC ladder logic program for automated motor start/stop control system. Implemented sensor-based input signals for safety interlock and fault detection.
projects.architecture:
Controller: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)
Programming: Ladder Logic (LD)
Components: Industrial Sensors, Safety Interlocks, Pushbuttons, Contactor Relays
projects.features: ["Designed PLC ladder logic program for automated motor start/stop control system","Implemented sensor-based input signals for safety interlock and fault detection","Simulated automation logic for industrial motor control operations","Demonstrated understanding of industrial automation workflow and troubleshooting logic"]
projects.challenges: Ensuring fail-safe operation where any sensor fault or wiring severance instantly de-energizes the motor.
projects.solution: Structured the ladder rungs with normally-closed (NC) safety loops, guaranteeing immediate emergency shutdown upon signal loss.
projects.result: Verified zero-defect operation across simulated industrial automation workflows.
